eras.source: Alabama Legislature 2017 remedial plans (Ala. Legislative Black Caucus v. Alabama)
eras.note: A three-judge panel struck 12 districts of the 2011 legislative maps as racial gerrymanders. Remedial plans were signed in May 2017 and approved by the court on 23 Oct 2017 for the 2018 and 2020 elections.

eras.label: current
eras.note: A VRA §2 challenge to the House map was dropped in December 2023 (plaintiffs narrowed their case to the Senate map only) — boundaries unchanged since enactment. Veto override requires only a simple majority, not an elevated supermajority.
